summary: Bind message senders and acceptance actors to the authenticated caller consistently on both message route forms, returning HTTP 403 for mismatched attribution.

replay.detail: Existing messages and claims are unchanged.

schema.detail: No client-v0, claim schema or generated-client changes. Existing message fields do not encode caller trust class; no new provenance field is introduced.

rules.detail: No claim registry or convergence rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Authenticated message attribution mismatches return HTTP 403 with foreign-agent-actor. Both /v1/messages and /v1/messages/ support the same send operation. Authenticated callers can clean up only their own mailbox, not all mailboxes. Bound callers, paired clients and native drivers retain their own attribution; local operator authority and validated lifecycle delegation remain unchanged.

recovery.detail: Existing idempotency and message recovery behavior is unchanged.
